summary_text: GPGI reported Q1 2026 results on May 7, 2026: pro forma adjusted net sales of $421.2M (+3% YoY), pro forma adjusted EBITDA $82.1M (-16% YoY), GAAP net loss of $235M. Shares fell ~12.7% pre-market and overall declined 25.52% post-earnings. CompoSecure delivered record ROS-driven performance; Husky hit by oil/resin price volatility and tariff uncertainty. 2026 guidance: $1.95B-$2.1B pro forma adjusted sales; $550M-$610M EBITDA. Board declared $0.0025 quarterly dividend on May 6, 2026, payable June 1, 2026.
